title: Server-Side Sparse Assignment for Federated Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: arXiv:2611.07093v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly recognized for their remarkable capabilities; federated learning (FL) offers a promising framework for collaboratively fine-tuning LLMs on edge devices while achieving data privacy. However, edge devices are inherently heterogeneous: clients may exhibit diverse data distributions and resource constraints, including limited memory and computation budgets. Recent federated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches address these challenges by using sparse expert activation or partial expert loading. However, existing partial-expert methods rely on heuristic full-pool observations or prioritize system-wide load balance, without guarantees for recovering client-specific relevant experts from partial observations. We propose $S^3$-MoE, a server-side sparse expert assignment framework that estimates client-specific expert relevance from partial observations and refines assignments through an exploit--expl

translated_title: 面向联邦混合专家模型的服务器端稀疏专家分配
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）因其卓越的能力而日益受到认可；联邦学习（FL）提供了一个有前景的框架，可在边缘设备上协作微调LLM的同时保障数据隐私。然而，边缘设备本质上具有异构性：客户端可能表现出多样化的数据分布和资源约束，包括有限的内存和计算预算。近期的联邦混合专家方法通过稀疏专家激活或部分专家加载来应对这些挑战。然而，现有的部分专家方法依赖于启发式的完整专家池观察，或优先考虑系统级的负载均衡，无法保证从部分观察中恢复客户端特定的相关专家。我们提出了S³-MoE，一个服务器端稀疏专家分配框架，它从部分观察中估计客户端特定的专家相关性，并通过“利用-探索”机制来细化专家分配……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出S³-MoE服务器端稀疏专家分配框架，从部分观察中估计客户端特定的专家相关性并通过利用-探索机制细化专家分配，解决联邦微调LLM中边缘设备异构性带来的专家匹配难题。
en_tdlr: Proposes S³-MoE, a server-side sparse expert assignment framework that estimates client-specific expert relevance from partial observations and refines assignments via an exploit-explore mechanism, addressing edge device heterogeneity in federated LLM fine-tuning.
